purpose: Exhaustive classification of F5 L4 environment receipts under the prospective root-bound locked-wheel amendment. gpu and gpu_uuid are raw Torch device-properties values; gpu_driver_query.name and gpu_driver_query.uuid are raw nvidia-smi CSV values. Admission normalizes only one exact leading GPU- from the SMI UUID before comparing it to the raw Torch UUID. GPU names compare exactly after CSV field trimming.

comparison.same_assignment: Every raw field, including UUID, host, affinity, installation roots and raw metadata hashes, must match.
comparison.cross_assignment_invariants: All fields remain equal after only the listed assignment-local representations are mapped. Installed contents, METADATA, WHEEL, wheel filename and SHA256, precision and numeric settings are never normalized away.

assignment_local: locked_wheels.*.raw_url only when it is the recorded F5_WHEELHOUSE file URI
root_normalization: Only the canonical hashes of RECORD and direct_url.json may remove the exact captured installation root. Every installed regular file listed by a locked wheel is retained and hashed. Files under site-packages, root-bound share data, root-bound headers, and root-bound bin scripts or executables are raw-byte invariant unless a bin script proves an exact installation-root/bin shebang. Only that proven script may canonicalize the exact root in its shebang, while its raw base64 bytes and raw hash remain in each receipt; RECORD is recomputed from that canonical script byte sequence. A bin file with a fixed, foreign, env, or otherwise non-root shebang remains raw-byte invariant. Root-bound classes are exhaustively bin (scripts and executables), share (data including man pages), and include (headers). Unknown classes, path escapes, symlinks, or missing files refuse. METADATA/WHEEL and all other installed-content hashes remain invariant. The raw Torch and SMI GPU values are retained. For same-assignment admission, SMI UUID must begin with exactly one case-sensitive GPU- prefix and its remainder must equal raw Torch gpu_uuid. Torch gpu and raw SMI name compare exactly after CSV field trimming; no name aliasing is permitted. The parsed driver fields remain invariant while only its raw UUID component is assignment-local.

required_build_proof: per-file installed contents and aggregate SHA256
raw base64 metadata bytes and raw/canonical hashes

optional.scipy: The numeric alias is null if and only if absent from both installed_packages and locked_wheels. Any installed SciPy retains full package/wheel evidence. The adopted L4 lock omits SciPy; no dependency or lock change is authorized.

packages.closure: Every locked wheel must have an installed package receipt. Bootstrap packages outside the lock remain fully captured. Torch/NumPy top-level versions must equal their installed package versions.

dynamic_maps.installed_packages: normalized distribution name -> exact package receipt; must contain all four required numeric packages and every locked wheel; optional SciPy is fully captured if installed; complete key set is invariant
dynamic_maps.installed_numeric_packages: exact alias projection of installed_packages for torch,numpy,numba,llvmlite,scipy; scipy alone is explicitly null when absent in installed and locked closures
dynamic_maps.locked_wheels: normalized report distribution name -> exact wheel receipt; every locked wheel must be installed, all four required numeric packages must be locked; optional SciPy requires matching installed/locked presence

leaf_rule_contract.matching: exact path segments; * matches one map key, including keys containing slash or dot
leaf_rule_contract.coverage: exactly one rule per present receipt leaf; lists are typed atomic leaves
leaf_rule_contract.aliases: installed_numeric_packages must exactly equal the five-name projection of installed_packages with explicit null for absent optional scipy
leaf_rule_contract.normalization: verified-raw-to-canonical fields remain raw evidence and are validated against exact canonical mappings; canonical hashes remain invariant

gpu_memory_observations.raw: gpu_memory retains the Torch total_memory integer in bytes. gpu_driver_query.memory_total retains the SMI integer MiB string. gpu_driver_query_raw retains the complete stdout including whitespace/newline.
gpu_memory_observations.consistency: Require positive integers and abs(gpu_memory - int(gpu_driver_query.memory_total) * 1048576) < 1048576. This symmetric sub-MiB bound permits only integer-MiB quantization. Differences of one MiB or greater, including API accounting differences, refuse; no unmeasured accounting offset is inferred.
gpu_memory_observations.comparison: Both observations and their unit declarations remain separate exact invariants across assignments; no conversion, rounding, or tolerance is applied to invariant equality. Same-assignment comparison retains every raw byte.

cross_source_semantics.gpu_uuid: Raw Torch CUuuid __str__ has no prefix. Require exactly one case-sensitive leading GPU- on raw SMI uuid; remove that one prefix from SMI only and compare remaining strings case-exact. Missing, empty, repeated, wrong-case prefix or differing tail refuses. Raw values never change.
cross_source_semantics.gpu_name: Exact case-sensitive Torch CUDA name versus parsed SMI name after CSV boundary whitespace trim only. No aliases or internal whitespace normalization; NVIDIA L4 is the realistic fixture.
cross_source_semantics.compute_capability: Raw Torch [8, 9] versus raw SMI 8.9: compare the two integer components using the inherited parser; never compare against CUDA or driver versions.
cross_source_semantics.gpu_memory: Raw Torch bytes versus SMI integer MiB (1048576 bytes). Inherited absolute discrepancy strictly less than one MiB; equality at one MiB refuses. No widened device-accounting offset.
cross_source_semantics.cpu: os.cpu_count() is host logical count, sched_getaffinity(0) is usable CPU IDs. Do not equate counts or IDs; require >=6 unique nonnegative allocated IDs. /proc/cpuinfo model/ISA and platform.processor are separate raw domains.
cross_source_semantics.versions_and_kernel: Driver version (550.54.15), Torch CUDA build (12.6), Torch (2.9.1+cu126), cuDNN integer (91002), cuDNN package (9.10.2.21), uname release/version, and platform.platform() retain distinct raw formats. Only Torch/NumPy runtime versions versus their installed distribution versions compare as exact same domains.

diagnostic_contract.admission: Any acquisition, schema, source consistency or runtime admission failure refuses. Invalid diagnostics never appear at environment.json. No qualification/science after refusal.
diagnostic_contract.collection: Each independent source is observed once. Continue sibling fields/packages after failure; unavailable fields stay null. Preserve raw SMI stdout before parsing and subprocess stdout/stderr (base64 for bytes) in acquisition_evidence.
diagnostic_contract.validation: Collect independent top-level, nested field, package/content/metadata and source consistency failures in deterministic order; dependencies that cannot be read remain explicit failures.
diagnostic_contract.exports: Before nonzero refusal, publish environment-raw.json and environment-diagnostic.json create-only with SHA256 sidecars and complete markers last. evidence_only=true, scientific_use_authorized=false. Unchanged supervisor collects completed diagnostics before raising child failure.

capture_provenance: capture_status is mandatory and must be SUCCESS. Acquisition, validation, configuration or reference-admission refusal sets REFUSED in the raw receipt and retains failure details there. Refusal-only keys are intentionally outside the admissible schema. Diagnostic envelopes and their refused raw contents are never reference evidence.
